title: Rules for the defects found by eye on the
notes: InteliFactu Documentos list and Modelos casilla panel (owner report).
result: nine new rules, `crowded-meta-line`, `date-locale`, `money-without-unit`, `list-dangling-rule`, `monospace-prose`, `unbreakable-overflow`, `redundant-total`, `label-wrap` (wrap half only) and `untranslated-text`; a new behaviour check `modal-dismiss` (backdrop click and Escape, reopened with the route's clicks); `fixed-overflow` extended to a sticky or fixed box taller than the space below its pin; `raw-placeholder` extended to identifiers (`taxRate`, `vat_rate`, `purchase:7905`). text-clipped missed the formula because it measures the element's box, not its glyphs, and stops at a scroller (a panel with `overflow-y: auto` computes `overflow-x: auto`). Probe reads `<html lang>`, the body font and `top`. Every rule is an error. The icon half of `label-wrap` and line-clamp stay open in `TODO.md`.
evidence: `tests/cli.data-display.integration.test.ts` (one failing page and one near-miss twin per rule, 27 tests); `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality test` 100 files, 359 tests passed with coverage thresholds; `lint`, `type-check`, `lint:fast`, `dupes` and `prettier --check` clean.
